description: Broadcasts a multiple-choice question and tallies live answers. Now with adaptive per-student difficulty (off by default; teacher-toggleable automatic/manual), a correctness streak and opt-in scoreboard per student, and live mid-session editing (replace the current question, skip ahead, or extend the timer) via a teacher_command control attribute. No real teacher UI yet -- all of this is driven by attributes for now. Install math-student alongside it to see the tally move.
author: prackoreal
